verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a dedicated seller catalog path. Merchants format products and variants as a CSV feed and upload it through the v2 Product Catalog Import API to a presigned URL. The docs cover recommended cadence (product data daily, inventory and pricing every 15 minutes), replace-mode deletion semantics, and import-status webhooks with per-row error CSVs. This is explicitly framed as sharing product, price, and availability with agents, which the agent side ingests as product feeds. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that feed imports work and actually surface products in agent surfaces; clarity on availability, since ACS is private preview, limited to certain regions, and requires per-agent approval before products reach a given agent.
